problems.title: The Superconducting Order Parameter
problems.statement: The magnitude squared of the Ginzburg-Landau order parameter is |psi|^2 = 0.64 in arbitrary units. What is the magnitude |psi|? Enter the numerical value.

problems.title: Constructing the GL Free Energy
problems.statement: For a uniform superconductor, the GL free-energy density is f = alpha|psi|^2 + beta|psi|^4/2. If alpha = -2 J/m^3 and |psi|^2 = 1, with beta = 4 J/m^3, calculate f in J/m^3.
problems.solution: Substituting the values gives f = (-2)(1) + (4)(1)^2/2 = 0 J/m^3.

problems.title: Finding the Equilibrium Order Parameter
problems.statement: Below the transition temperature, alpha = -3 and beta = 12 in consistent units. Using |psi|^2 = -alpha/beta, calculate |psi|^2.

problems.title: The Coherence Length
problems.statement: The GL coherence length is xi = sqrt(hbar^2/(2m|alpha|)). If hbar^2/(2m) = 2.0 x 10^-14 J m^2 and |alpha| = 8.0 x 10^-3 J/m^3, calculate xi in nm.

problems.title: The London Penetration Depth from GL Theory
problems.statement: A GL calculation gives a penetration depth lambda = 120 nm and coherence length xi = 30 nm. Calculate the GL parameter kappa = lambda/xi.

problems.title: Calculating the GL Parameter
problems.statement: A type-II superconductor has coherence length xi = 10 nm and penetration depth lambda = 25 nm. Calculate kappa = lambda/xi.

problems.title: Critical Fields from GL Theory
problems.statement: For a type-II superconductor, the upper critical field is Bc2 = Phi0/(2 pi xi^2). Using Phi0 = 2.068 x 10^-15 Wb and xi = 10 nm, calculate Bc2 in tesla.

problems.title: The Energy of a Superconducting Vortex
problems.statement: The approximate vortex energy per unit length is E = (Phi0^2/(4 pi mu0 lambda^2)) ln(kappa). Use Phi0 = 2.068 x 10^-15 Wb, mu0 = 4 pi x 10^-7 H/m, lambda = 100 nm, and kappa = 10. Give E in units of 10^-12 J/m.
problems.solution: Substitution gives E approximately 1.20 x 10^-12 J/m.

problems.title: The Abrikosov Vortex Lattice
problems.statement: A triangular Abrikosov lattice has vortex density n = 1.0 x 10^14 m^-2. Estimate the intervortex spacing a using a = sqrt(2/(sqrt(3)n)). Give a in nm.

problems.title: Ginzburg–Landau Challenge
problems.statement: A superconductor has lambda = 150 nm and xi = 50 nm. Using Bc2 = Phi0/(2 pi xi^2), calculate the upper critical field in tesla. Use Phi0 = 2.068 x 10^-15 Wb.
